metadata.description: Agent Skills that tidy one room of your digital life each. They work without the momputer app.

plugins.name: momputer-skills
plugins.description: All eleven skills in one install: look without changing anything, show one page, act only on what you tick.

plugins.name: mom
plugins.description: Teaches an agent to clean up after itself: stop what it started, take out its own trash, put reports where they belong.

plugins.name: tidy-folders
plugins.description: Surveys a Windows PC's folders and moves only what you approve into place, with an undo.

plugins.name: desktop-icons
plugins.description: Tidies a cluttered Windows desktop: dead and duplicate shortcuts, loose files and installers.

plugins.name: rename-documents
plugins.description: Gives scans and downloads names you can find later, old and new side by side.

plugins.name: disk-space-report
plugins.description: Shows where a Windows PC's disk space went, and the safe way to get each part back.

plugins.name: backup-checkup
plugins.description: Answers "if this disk died today, what would I lose?".

plugins.name: inbox-cleanup
plugins.description: Reviews two months of Gmail: who fills your inbox, what you never open, what to unsubscribe from.

plugins.name: calendar-fixer
plugins.description: Reviews your Google Calendar: double bookings, no breaks, stale recurring meetings.

plugins.name: drive-audit
plugins.description: Reviews Google Drive: what's shared with anyone, what fills your storage, duplicates.

plugins.name: subscription-audit
plugins.description: Finds what you pay for again and again, and what it costs a year.

plugins.name: bookmark-cleanup
plugins.description: Tidies browser bookmarks into a new file you import; never touches the browser's own.
